prompts: Massive nuclear detonation heard from a few kilometres away: a sharp cracking blast, then a deep sub-bass rumble that rolls on and on, low thunder echoing across a valley, slowly fading. Cinematic, no music.
Colossal atomic bomb explosion, extremely deep low-frequency boom, ground shaking, a roaring wall of wind and debris after the blast, long rolling tail. Realistic, no music.
Distant thermonuclear blast: a heavy thud, a short silence, then the shockwave arrives with a huge roar and rattling, followed by a long low rumble echoing off mountains. No music.
Gigantic nuclear explosion close by, earth-shattering boom with crackling fire and a howling shockwave wind, glass and debris, then a deep rumble dying away. Cinematic, no music.
Cold War air-raid siren, a single large mechanical siren winding up and wailing up and down over a city, slightly distant and echoing. No voices, no music.
Military base nuclear attack alarm: a loud electronic klaxon blaring in a fast repeating pattern, metallic and urgent, in a concrete bunker. No voices, no music.
Old civil defence siren starting slowly and rising to a long steady wail, a second siren further away joining in, eerie and ominous. No voices, no music.

Nuclear attack warning siren: a large mechanical air-raid siren that winds up fast from a low growl to a loud piercing wail within the first second, holds the high wail, then winds down at the end. Loud, close, slightly echoing over a city. No voices, no music.

Cold War civil defence siren, one powerful rotating horn, quick rising wind-up to a high screaming tone, a short sustained wail with a slight up and down, then a short fall. Ominous, urgent. No voices, no music.

Air-raid siren rising quickly from deep to very high pitch, a long ominous howl echoing between buildings, a second distant siren slightly behind it, ends with the pitch dropping. No voices, no music.
Heavy industrial nuclear alarm siren, mechanical motor spinning up rapidly, rising shriek, pulsing wail at full volume, then spinning down. Gritty, metallic, cinematic. No voices, no music.
